name.description: Vanity name for this Source/Client

identifier.description: The **fully-qualified** handle, or identifier, for your Atmosphere account

appPassword.description: The [App Password](https://atproto.com/specs/xrpc#app-passwords) you created for your Atmosphere account

maxRequestRetries.description:
default # of http **request** retries a source/client can make before error is thrown

retryMultiplier.description: default retry delay multiplier (retry attempt * multiplier = # of seconds to wait before retrying)

configureAs.description: Should always be `client` when using Tealfm as a client

enable.description: Should MS parse this config and create a client/source from it?

autoMonitor.description: Set the default behavior for wether this component should automatically monitor any activity, or scrobble, it encounters

a test

refreshEnabled.description: Try to get fresh scrobble history from client when tracks to be scrobbled are newer than the last scrobble found in client history

refreshStaleAfter.description: Refresh scrobbled plays from upstream service if last refresh was at least X seconds ago

refreshMinInterval.description: Minimum time (milliseconds) required to pass before upstream scrobbles can be refreshed.

refreshInitialCount.description: The number of tracks to retrieve on initial refresh (related to scrobbleBacklogCount).

deadLetterRetries.description: Number of times MS should automatically retry Plays in dead letter queue

checkExistingScrobbles.description: Check client for an existing scrobble at the same recorded time as the "new" track to be scrobbled.

scrobbleInterval.description: Minimum time (milliseconds) to wait between scrobbles sent to this Client

verbose.description: Options used for increasing verbosity of logging in MS (used for debugging)

onNoMatch.description: Log to DEBUG when a new track does NOT match an existing scrobble

onMatch.description: Log to DEBUG when a new track DOES match an existing scrobble

confidenceBreakdown.description: Include confidence breakdowns in track match logging, if applicable

playTransform.description: Enhance/correct Play data by applying a transform pipeline

preCompare.description: Stages applied when Play is first seen
